source: 7 preserved LOG-M identities + 25 dedicated falsifying and preserving cases

rules.mandatory: All must be implemented and executed in real Odoo 19 Enterprise as applicable; related static checks do not substitute for runtime
rules.no_false_pass: All results start NOT_RUN; fail/unknown/skip mandatory test blocks make pr unless owner separately reauthorizes exact obligation
rules.bind_to_tree: Each execution must record exact final commit/tree, fixture fingerprint, command, output/log ref and status
rules.historical: ML-R-17 requires operator-authorized historical real-pattern dataset on a protected clone; synthetic-only proof is insufficient

tests.fixture: transaction with 0, 1, 3 separately identified physical loads
tests.pass_assertion: load.transaction_id persisted and tx.load_ids is exact inverse; 0/1/3 traversal consistent

tests.fixture: load L0 already owned by transaction A; transaction B tries to claim it
tests.pass_assertion: Rebind rejected, A remains owner, no history altered
tests.forbidden_outcome: Second transaction obtains same load without explicit approved correction

tests.fixture: one SO with multiple worksheet transactions, load with no exact independent reference
tests.pass_assertion: Load remains unattached and one review disposition is retained

tests.fixture: two companies share an external SO number, load from one company
tests.pass_assertion: Cross-company association rejected and read rights remain constrained

tests.fixture: one uniquely attributable SO transaction and second real load on same SO
tests.pass_assertion: Both loads link to the same unique transaction through source-proven association

tests.fixture: legacy tx.load_id read with two different legitimate loads
tests.pass_assertion: Singular API returns deliberate unresolved or explicit ambiguity without selecting load A or B
